intro: Trade with the businesses you buy from and sell to, connected to yours. Orders, delivery notes, invoices and payment advice travel between your books and theirs, and you settle up with statements, netting, disputes and returns.
start: Turn the network on and send your documents for verification in Settings › Network. Only verified businesses can be found or connect.
Connect with a supplier or a customer you trade with, and choose what travels between you.
Map their product codes to yours in Item maps, so their orders arrive with the right items.
Send your first purchase order to a connected supplier from its page.

articles.summary: Find a verified business by its network ID or registration number, or swap a code, and connect once both agree.
before: Your business must have the network turned on and be verified. Connections says so if it is not, with a link to do it.

articles.after: When they accept, the connection is active and they are named as your customer or supplier. Open the connection to choose what you send and what you accept, under What travels.
